name: cf-templates-webhooks
description: A webhook receiver with an admin panel behind Cloudflare Access: create endpoints, check each sender's signature, store every delivery once in D1 and read them in the panel.

scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run db:migrate && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && wrangler deploy --dry-run

DB.description: Stores your endpoints and every webhook they receive. The deploy command applies its tables (migrations/).

RATE_LIMITER.description: Caps each endpoint at 300 deliveries a minute, so one noisy sender cannot flood the others.

BRAND_NAME.description: Company name shown in the admin panel.

RETENTION_DAYS.description: How many days a webhook is kept after its latest delivery, for example `30`. A daily job deletes older ones.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, for example `https://menethil.cloudflareaccess.com`. The admin panel stays locked until this and `ACCESS_AUD` are set.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Application Audience (AUD) Tag of the Access application that protects `/admin`.
